title: Weak approximation of generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads
statement: Use the infinity-category and universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and the ordinary and generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability]. Let $f:M\to O$ be an inert-preserving map of small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads, with $O$ ordinary. Inert edges mean cocartesian edges over opposites of inclusions of consecutive subintervals in $\Delta$; active edges lie over maps whose opposite preserves both endpoints. A categorical fibration of quasicategories means an inner fibration, in the sense of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], which lifts equivalences with any prescribed source. For such an $f$, an object $C\in M$, and any arrow $\alpha:X\to f(C)$ in $O$, let $\mathcal F_f(C,\alpha)$ be the infinity category of factorizations $X\xrightarrow{\gamma} f(D)\xrightarrow{f(\beta)} f(C)$ of $\alpha$, where $\beta:D\to C$ lies in $M$ and $\gamma$ is inert in $O$. An object includes the coherent triangle $f(\beta)\gamma\simeq\alpha$. A morphism to $(\beta':D'\to C,\gamma')$ is an edge $h:D\to D'$ together with coherent triangles $\beta'h\simeq\beta$ and $f(h)\gamma\simeq\gamma'$ compatible with that triangle; include all higher simplices of these data. Equivalently it is the full subcategory on inert $\gamma$ of the category of such coherent factorizations. The categorical fibration $f$ is a weak approximation if $\mathcal F_f(C,\alpha)$ is weakly contractible for every $C$ and every $\alpha$. Here weakly contractible means that the underlying simplicial set has weakly contractible geometric realization. A general $f$ is a weak approximation if it factors, over $O$ and up to coherent equivalence, as $M\xrightarrow{e}M'\xrightarrow{g}O$ with $e$ an equivalence of generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads and $g$ a categorical fibration which is a weak approximation as just defined.
